ns2:section.sectionText: LIS graduate students; other graduate students need permission of instructor to enroll (mwolske@illinois.edu). 2 or 4 GR hours; be sure to enroll in your desired credit amount. A non-waived course fee of $55 (field trip fee) will be assessed to the student's tuition and fees bill; students may incur additional expenses in relation to their individual practical engagement activities. Meets with LIS 490STU. See course information at http://courseweb.lis.illinois.edu/~mwolske/lis490st/syllabusFall13-LIS490ST.pdf
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
